balls.text: short ball and it has been pulled away by Vinay Kumar for a six! End of an excellent over spoiled by that shot!
slogs and caught by Raina at mid-off! Five wickets in six balls! They have yet to get to 200!

run-out! Outside the off-stump and it is dabbed away, where Bolliner runs, picks up and sees that Vettori is way outside the crease. He rolls it down the ground much like Trevor Chappell's infamous underarm ball and hits the stump!
full-toss swung away to square-leg for a single.
bowled him! Bollinger has another one and is on a hat-trick. On the middle stump and Pujara went for a slog over mid-wicket. He missed and the result is a flat stump.
yep, the strength had gone from his arms and that is spooned away to the long-on fielder where du Plessis takes an excellent catch over his head.
full-toss and it has spooned straight to deep mid-wicket where Raina dives in front and takes a good catch! Tiwary's gone for eight.
down the leg-side in an attempt to cramp the batsman up but is easily flicked away for a couple.
goes down the track and chips it towards the short third-man fielder for a single.
drills it down the ground through to long-off for a single. Kohli back on...
full-toss and smacked it back to the bowler, four runs!
full-toss outside the off-stump and driven to the fielder.
slower one, too many of them in this spell for Morkel and he has stylishly flicked it away for a six!
goes down the track and then slaps it to deep square-leg for a couple. Kohli has brought up his 50 and the celebration is muted and exhausted!
he has been struggling with the timing, but not this time. He waited for the slower one and then pulled it over the mid-wicket fence for a six!
slower again and shorter again! Tiwary pulls it away to mid-wicket for a single.
gone! slower, shorter and AB de Villiers goes for a reverse hook! This time it does not connect and goes straight to the short third-man fielder and his shot stay ends.
pitched on the leg-stump, good length and Kohli spanks it to long-off for a single.
inside-out and the gap between sweeper and long-off is split by AB de Villiers. Four off the very first ball!
down the leg-side, wanted to sweep it away but missed. Umpires calls it a wide.
inside out shot from Kohli, who isn't getting his timing right. Goes to long-off for a single.
goes down the track and misses! Byes called and that confirms my belief that it was a missed stumping.
full-toss and played away to the right of long-on for a couple of runs.
down the leg-side and it is a wide.

finally gone and it is Jadeja who picks up the wicket of Gayle! Outside the off-stump and pitched right up, and Gayle went for the slash, but only managed to slice it away. Bravo caught hold of that one easily.
full-toss on the legs and a single for Kohli.
drives hard and back to the bowler, but only for a single.
edge outside the off-stump and a single to the short third-man.
pitched up, just a push outside the off-stump and guess what, it has gone away to the fence! Century beckons...
comes down and plays it away to the leg-side for a run.
finally, finally! Kohli gets his unorthodox strokes right! Outside the off-stump and Kohli reverse sweeps it away.
flighted up on the off-stump driven to the covers and the fielder throws it to Dhoni, who whips the bails away. Third-umpire called for but Kohli is just in.
full-toss and Kohli has finally got in the middle of his bat to the fence. Bravo is not chuffed!
goes down the pitch and Bravo pitches it right up and outside the off-stump, can only manage to drive it long-on.
down the leg-side and Gayle smartly leaves it alone for the umpire to call it wide.
drilled through the covers for a single.
outside the off-stump, pitched right up to the bat and Kohli misses getting any bat. Not only is Kohli struggling but he could end up frustrating Gayle, who looks murderous right now.
full-toss from Bravo and it is driven straight to long-on. It was whipped to the fielder and he struggled to get hold of it!
slower one and Gayle has tonked it into the roof. Or has it gone out of the stadium? Tom Moody says it should be worth 12. New box balls being called for I think.
goes down the track but yorks himself and gets nothing out of it. Kohli is frustrating himself here.
reverse sweep attempted but can get only till the point fielder.
short and wide this time and it is cut away to the sweeper. Gayle had 11 runs off his first 11 balls!
and again! Gone into the crowds in the deep square-leg region and that brings up his 50.
pitched right up to Gayle and he has smacked it over the long-on fielder. It was a decent idea, but it turned out to be a full-toss!
flighted slightly and outside the off-stump, Gayle wanted to cut it away but goes to the fielder.
Kohli goes down the track yet again and for the umpteenth time, he misses his swing!
slower one yet again, he is changing his pace up as a variation. Played away to the off-side but no timing on it.
tapped it away to the off-side for a single.
driven through to the long-off region for a single.
bulleted through the covers by Gayle but they have a fielder in the deep there!
slower one from Bravo and Kohi flicks it away to the deep square-leg fielder.
drives him to long-off and the batsmen stroll through for an easy single. Looking ominous for Chennai.
pitched on the middle and Gayle drives it to long-on for a single.
wide outside the off-stump and Gayle cuts it away to the fence. First four for Gayle, Jakati seemed to be fearing that shot over long-on and bowled it wide outside the off-stump.
punched off the back-foot by Kohli for a single.
goes for an expansive shot as you would expect from Gayle but it goes to the square-leg.
aah, poor ball from Jakati, down the leg-side and Gayle and Dhoni both miss it. Through for five wides!
drives through to the left of long-off
pitched right up and Kohli drives it to long-on for a single.
Kohli finally gets it away! The wicket-keeper was up, Kohli remained planted on his crease and cut it away through point for a four!
Kohli goes down the track yet again and he misses the pull this time. Three or four times now, he has done this.
shortish again and Gayle gave himself room to pull. The slowness of the ball did not allow him the timing he required.
short of length and driven on the up by Kohli for a single to the sweeper fielder.
slower one and nudged away by Gayle for a single.
Kohli goes down the track and tries to cut it away but is beaten. Why would you do that when you can play strokes like the flick he just played that over?
punched it back to the bowler for no run.
flicked away and the gap is picked really well by Kohli. Bisects fine-leg and deep square.
slower one yet again and Gayle defends it on the back-foot and rushes away for a single. That was a bit of ginger running from Gayle.
down the leg-side and Kohli flicks it away to the fine-leg for a single.
flashes outside the off-stump and the slower one kept a tad low yet again.
defended by Gayle and no run for the big man!
off the back-foot and Gayle has smacked the short ball over the long-on region yet again! Three sixes for Gayle after he scored 11 off 11!
down the leg-side and its wide.
played away to the leg-side for a single. Bravo's direct hit would have had Kohli in trouble
throws his bat for the third time in the over but goes to the fielder at long-on this time.
Six more! This looked mistimed and it just clears the long-on fielder!
Gayle has teed off! Raina has been hit into the long-on stands to get Gayle his first six!
played away to the leg-side for a single. Gayle's now played 11 balls for 11 runs. No threes, no fours, no sixes in his innings so far!
short ball from Morkel, slower again but it goes over the tall Gayle, prompting the umpire to call it a wide.
slower one outside the off-stump and Kohli has guided it away to the third-man region for a single.
defended back to the bowler by Kohli.
down the leg-side and that is his second wide. Gayle wanted to get a tickle on to that one.
played away to the off-side for a single.
slower one, bouncer and Gayle stood really tall and defends well. Goes to short third-man for a single
beaten outside the off-side! Did that one keep a tad low? Kohli tried to steer him to third-man but it sneaked through.
short of length and driven back to the bowler
on the middle-stump, flicked away to short mid-wicket.
slower one and Kohli tickles it really fine down the leg-side.Goes to the fine-leg fence to get him his first boundary.
cut away by Gayle but he gets only a single yet again, his seventh single in as many balls.
pitched up and driven to long-on for a single.
Kohli drives it to the left of mid-off and runs away for a single.

Gayle went down the track and tried to punch it over mid-off, but it went on the bounce to the fielder. Bravo was at mid-off and eh threw the stumps down at the non-striker's end but Gayle was just in.
flicked away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single.
defends on the off-side towards the covers.
short ball and this time he top-edges the ball straight to mid-on. This was a simple catch again and Bravo catches it easily.
short ball tried by Morkel and it seemed like a good variation until the umpire decided it was too high. Wide called.
tapped on the off-side and he runs away for a single. Agarwal is back on strike.
played back to the bowler for nothing.
Sweeps again and that goes for another six! Ashwin's not getting any turn and Agrawal's turning it on the heat (as if its not hot already)!
defended back to the bowler
Shot Sir! Man was up at mid-on and Agrawal smacked it over long-on, goes all the way!
knocked it to the leg-side and Gayle happily gives the strike back to Agrawal.
played away to deep square-leg for a single. Gayle gets strike now.
punches it through the covers and gets a single.

that is the shot of all shots played so far from Agrawal! Slower delivery and Agrawal picked that up really well, punched it over mid-off and it has gone all the way! It was Bollinger who had dropped him earlier...
short ball from Bollinger and Agrawal tries to pull it away but it goes away to the square-leg fielder. Gayle is refusing a lot of singles here.
walks towards the bowler and tried to smash him over mid-off but goes one bounce to the fielder. Wanted the single but Gayle sends him back.
pitched up yet again and this is a short arm jab over mid-off that goes away to the fence. Good touch for Agrawal so far, also allowing Gayle to settle down.
pitched right up to Agrawal outside the off-stump and he goes for the full-bloodied drive. Goes as far as mid-off only.
on-driven to Murali Vijay at deep square-leg, who was miked up and talking to the commentators. Doesn't affect his concentration and a single is all that they get.

dropped! What a clanger! Agrawal has been attempting sweeps and this time he gets one off the middle and went straight into the hands of Bollinger. Sweaty palms or whatever else, this should have been caught!
shot over mid-off and Agrawal is doing what most thought Gayle would! This has almost gone all the way!
finally gets some bat on the sweep and they rush back for a couple.
cramps him for room outside the leg-side and again a shot attempted in anger. Hits his pads.
flighted on the leg-stump and Agrawal wants to go over mid-wicket. Misses.
runs down the pitch and wants to thrash it through the leg-side but the lack of bounce seems to beat him.
pitched up yet again and Agrawal threw his bat at it. Goes to the sweeper fielder, who was put in place two balls ago.
flashes hard at it but this one was pitched slightly shorter and beats him.
whoa! What piece of timing from Agrawal and that's gone away! He was defending it on the off-side and it went to the fence through the covers
bit of bounce for Bollinger and Agarwal jumps up in an attempt to keep it down. Wanted a single but the languid Gayle sends him back.
pitched right up to the bat and punched to the cover fielder.
badly released and it went high and wide and almost straight to the wicket-keeper! Wide even by Test match standards!
played away to the leg-side for a couple of runs down to deep square-leg.
Defended back to the bowler
down the leg-side and Gayle flicks it away to fine-leg. No fielder outside the circle and Gayle comes back for a couple.
Tapped away to the leg-side towards deep mid-wicket, where one of the two fielders outside the circle fields and that brings Gayle to strike.
on the off-stump and lofted over the mid-off player for four! Bangalore is away.
around the wicket, on the leg-stump, defended back to the bowler.
edged away and that has gone away to the fence for a four! Chennai have absolutely stunned the Bangalore side and won their second of four games, and I must add, out of nowhere!
short, pulled away and the batsman gets a single! The probability of a Super Over gets higher. But the new man Jadeja is on strike!
cut attempted and the batsman gets nothing on it!
full-toss, outside the off-stump and he slashes it. Okay wait, how did that go for a six? It was a dipping full-toss and it has gone for a six? Incredible!
that is definitely a no-ball! Gone above the waist height, oh it was above at his chest probably! And the pull shot went as a top-edge to the fine-leg for a four.
oh he is out this time! Pitched outside the off-stump and it was fullish, Morkel went for a slash but only managed to give an easy catch to the sweeper fielder.
pitched up and drives it straight to long-off for a single
HUGE! HUGE! HUGE! That is a biggest of the lot over long-on and Albie Morkel has changed this match on its head as Kohli concedes 28 off the over!
full-toss and Morkel has played it away to the wide long-on for a couple. They need 21 from 7.
Gone, gone, gone! The ball has been sent away over the fence yet again! That is a six over the long-on region and that is 20 off the over. This move will be questioned if Bangalore lose this...
shorter one and the thick outside edge takes it to the fine third-man for another four! 14 off the over so far!
again pitched up and this time he has been smacked over the long-on fence! Too full from Kohli and the power takes over!
pitched right up and the inside-edge gets the batsman four. They need to score at four a ball from here.
gone this time, it was a bit of an exhausted helicopter stroke and it went wrong. Caught at long-off. Zaheer has another wicket and the asking rate gets higher. And more improbable.

shorter one yet again and Dhoni went for the pull, got the toe of the bat mostly and it goes to long-on. The fielder threw it back to the bowler, who tried to break the stumps before he had the ball in his hands.
shorter one, kept a little low and Bravo's pull goes only up to the short fine-leg fielder.
swing and missed! Slower ball and Bravo wanted to send it to the Caribbean. Instead, it rolls over to the wicket-keeper.
pitched up and drilled back to long-off, but the fielder was straight enough to stop it.

again, pushed down the leg-side and Dhoni clips it away for a couple of runs. Murali ran well on the fence to field it and throw the ball back to the keeper, who broke the stumps, but the batsman was in.
down the leg-side and this is a wide. Trying to cramp Dhoni, given the field on the off-side is up, inside the circle.
clipped away over the leg-side for a couple of runs, getting 14 off the over.
full-toss yet again and this time it is over the batsman's waist! Dhoni wanted to play it through the short third-man but did not get the gap.
wide ball, outside the off-stump and that is left all alone by the Chennai captain. Wide called.
missed a full-toss! That was on the off-stump and a full-toss that needed a little bat to get to the fence.
round arm action again this time but Dhoni was waiting, and once he saw what was coming, he smashed it away, over the long-on region for a six!
slower one, played away to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
outside the off-stump, full and made it difficult for Dhoni to get some bat on it.
slower one, dabbed away to the deep point and another piece of excellent running from Dhoni!
short and this was on to the batsman rather quickly, Dhoni managed to get it to long-on for a single.
played away to the leg-side for a single. Nine off the over with a ball remaining
driven to long-on for a single.
on the middle-stump and Dhoni whips it away for a couple of runs.
pitched right up, into the batsman and he drives it to long-on for a single.
played away, superbly, through the third-man, who was inside the circle!
driven to long-on for a single and that is the end of an excellent spell from Muralitharan!
pitched on the middle, hits the pad and Murali appeals in a style not too many possess! Not-out, the umpire says.
full-toss and driven to the wide long-on and that looked like it was going to the boundary but Kohli dived and stopped it
Murali has his third wicket! du Plessis was looking good but he knew that the asking rate was getting steeper and this time he goes down the track and holes out to long-on.
top-spinner, short, tried to cut it away but does not get it off the middle.
goes down the track but does not get off the middle of the bat.
wanted to go down the pitch again but gets no bat there.
Vettori's taking a pasting here as du Plessis flat-bats it over the bowler's head for six. The ball curved away in its flight but did not stop it from going to the fence.
sweeps it and it goes fine as well, but does not gather too much pace and only a single
drives to long-off for a single.

Is that out? has Dilshan pulled off a sizzler? He was back-pedalling and caught it well at long-off, threw it back into the playing arena and then catches it again, but...but while catching it for the first time, his foot hit the fence!
full-toss and driven to the long-on region for a single.
dabbed it to the leg-side again and he rounds it off with a single.
keeps a little low, on the leg-stump and Dhoni has back at nudging it away to the leg-side and he comes back for two.
played away to the leg-side for a single. 12 already off this over.
played away to the leg-side for a run.
pitched right up to the batsman and Dhoni has had enough of that dabbing and nudging! He smacks it over the bowler and the sightscreen for a six!
short and cut away to the point fence for four.
Played away to the leg-side for a single.
full-toss and driven back to the bowler. Vettori dives to his left and saves the single
down the leg-side and Dhoni nudges it away to square-leg for a couple of runs. Good running between the wickets with the required rate now at 13.
drives to the long-off region for a run.
played away to the off-side but for no run
goes down the track and swings hard, gets a thick inside edge and they get a couple.

run-out appeal! Dhoni was charging back for the second run after dabbing the ball away to the leg-side and the fielder threw the stumps down direct. But for one, AB had pushed the stumps down with his gloves and by the time the direct hit took the stump down, Dhoni was back in his crease.
played gently away to the off-side for a single.
played away to the off-side but to the fielder.

Gone! Murali has his second wicket and Raina has holed out to the long-on fielder, who was one of the three fielders on the leg-side, outside the circle. Raina's brief stay ends and Chennai's lost their second.
on the leg-stump and played away for a single.
on the middle-stump and that is easily played away to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
looking for the yorker but turns into a full-toss and Raina caresses it away through the point region for a four!
shorter one and Raina has hooked it away in a manner that is so reminiscent of him! It goes over fine-leg for a six!
brings his fifty up with a push to the off-side.
pitched right up to the bat and he drives through the covers. It was another slower ball from Vinay Kumar there.
on the middle stump, slightly slower and du Plessis plays it. This was bowled with a round arm action, a la Malinga! Surprised the batsman a little..
plays away to the off-side for a single.
pushed away to the off-side for a single.
sweep attempted by Raina but he fails to get any bat on it.
defends it on the off-side once again.
defends it away to the leg-side.
short ball and Raina has pulled it away and....what do we have here! How did he let that one go? It was going straight to the fielder at long-on and he seems to have over-run it.
worked it from outside the off-stump to the fine-leg region for a single.
outside the off-stump and he tries to cut it away. Again does not get the timing on that one and the ball goes straight to the fielder.
full-toss and drilled to long-on. Went to the right of Zaheer Khan, managed to get his hands to it but the ball slid away from him.
pitched right up and dug out to long-on for a single.
short ball and Raina fails to get any timing on that pull. Pops up in front of long-on for a single.
short from Kohli and du Plessis pulls it away to deep square-leg.
driven to long-off for a single.
played on the front-foot and dabbed it away to the leg-side for a single.
what a catch! He is getting to 40 years of age but that is not going to deter him from flinging himself to the leg-side, in front of the non-striker and pulled off a beauty!
Doosra and Vijay seemed to have picked it. Dabbed away to the off-side
pitched right up and driven straight back to long-on.
dabs it away to the leg-side and he calls for two. Vijay responds well and they get a couple.
Goes on to the back-foot and plays it away to the leg-side.

du Plessis is doing what Mayank Agarwal was doing for Bangalore and this time he has smacked the bowler over the mid-wicket region for a six. Nothing wrong with the ball except that it did not have too much pace to challenge the batsman!
on the middle-stump and played away to the leg-side for a single.
smartly played away to the leg-side and they run back for the second. Vijay was run-out in the previous game and started off a tad shakily today, but this is better running.
pitched right up to the batsman and he drives it to mid-on for a single.
Huge! That's gone for a big six! Short of a good length ball and du Plessis has dismissed it away from his presence disdainfully.
played away to the leg-side. Almost mistimed as it stayed low but still managed to beat the in-field.
shuffled in his crease and played away to the off-side but straight to the point fielder.
smack! Short and this was the quicker one and Vijay has deposited it to the mid-wicket region for his first four!
another slower one and du Plessis drives it on the up to long-off. The keeper goes back with Vijay on strike.
slower one and that is played away to the off-side. The wicket-keeper is up to the stumps.
this is flicked away by Vijay to deep square-leg for a single. Moves on to three.
short of length, on the middle and it is flicked away to the deep square-leg region for a single.
flicked away to the deep square-leg region for a single.
shortens his length, drives to the extra-cover region.
Shot! That has been hit over mid-off and it goes for four. du Plessis has been walking down the track and this time he gets it off the middle.
slower one, but a short one as well and du Plessis pulled it with some ease! Over mid-wicket for four.
down the leg-side and Vijay tries to flick it away, misses, hits the pads and gets a single leg-bye.
he goes down the track yet again and only managed a top-slice that almost carried to the third-man. Zaheer wasn't happy that the fielder did not go for the catch...
he goes down the wicket yet again and flicks it to the deep square-leg region for a single.
played away to the leg-side for a single to deep square-leg
drives on the up to long-off for a single.
tapped it away to the leg-side.
giving him some room and the batsman cuts it away to the fence.
goes down the track and gets it to square-leg.
Vijay defends it to the off-side and there is no run again.
defended yet again and it rolls away to the leg-side. The running is not the best at the moment.
short and du Plessis has punched away through the covers for a four!
comes down the track and tries to play it to the leg-side but does not get anything on his bat.
defends on the leg-side and no run again.
comes into the bat and du Plessis gets an inside edged to the leg-side. Vijay wants a single but the batsman sends him back.
played away to the leg-side and that ends a rather quickly bowled first over. Well bowled too!
on to the back-foot and gets an inside-edge to the leg-side.
short and outside the off-stump and he dabs it to point.
nudged away to the leg-side and he has his first run in two games.
goes on to the back-foot, nudges it away to the leg-side and wants a single. Sent back.
drives to the covers and straight to the fielder.
